messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://microfluidics.utoronto.ca/papers/hvab180.pdf
Paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.1093/clinchem/hvab180

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Digital Microfluidic Hemagglutination Assays for Blood Typing, Donor Compatibility Testing, and Hematocrit Analysis

REAGENTS USED:
  - Whole Blood
  - Reconstitution Solvent
  - Anti-A, Anti-B, Anti-AB, and Anti-D Blood Typing Antibodies (lyophilized)
  - Hematocrit Reagent (chemical agglutination agent)

STEPS:
1. Reconstitute lyophilized antibodies and hematocrit reagents using the reconstitution solvent and mix for 5s.
2. Meter whole-blood unit-droplets for each parallel test channel (A, B, AB, D, and hematocrit).
3. Merge each whole-blood droplet with its respective reconstituted reagent and mix for 10s to form the test droplet.
4. Perform digital aperture absorbance detection (DAAD) imaging readout to score agglutination states for the ABO/RhD blood-typing panel.
5. Apply threshold conditions to selectively dispose of nonagglutinated (negative) droplets, and perform quantitative DAAD scoring for hematocrit.
6. Clear all remaining test droplets from the array.

ir.content:
bsbbif_2_t:
	dispose(test_a1[0])
bsbbif_3_f:
	PHI test_a2 = {test_a1,test_a}
	if score_b1[0] <= 15	|	true: jump bsbbif_4_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_5_f
main:
	solvent_a1[0] = dispense(reconstitution_solvent)
	solvent_b1[0] = dispense(reconstitution_solvent)
	solvent_ab1[0] = dispense(reconstitution_solvent)
	solvent_d1[0] = dispense(reconstitution_solvent)
	solvent_hct1[0] = dispense(reconstitution_solvent)
	dry_a1[0] = dispense(anti_A)
	dry_b1[0] = dispense(anti_B)
	dry_ab1[0] = dispense(anti_AB)
	dry_d1[0] = dispense(anti_D)
	dry_hct1[0] = dispense(hematocrit_reagent)
	reagent_a1[0] = mix(solvent_a1[0], dry_a1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	reagent_b1[0] = mix(solvent_b1[0], dry_b1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	reagent_ab1[0] = mix(solvent_ab1[0], dry_ab1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	reagent_d1[0] = mix(solvent_d1[0], dry_d1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	reagent_hct1[0] = mix(solvent_hct1[0], dry_hct1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	blood_a1[0] = dispense(whole_blood)
	blood_b1[0] = dispense(whole_blood)
	blood_ab1[0] = dispense(whole_blood)
	blood_d1[0] = dispense(whole_blood)
	blood_hct1[0] = dispense(whole_blood)
	test_a1[0] = mix(blood_a1[0], reagent_a1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	test_b1[0] = mix(blood_b1[0], reagent_b1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	test_ab1[0] = mix(blood_ab1[0], reagent_ab1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	test_d1[0] = mix(blood_d1[0], reagent_d1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	test_hct1[0] = mix(blood_hct1[0], reagent_hct1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	score_a1[0] = detect(fluorescence, test_a1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	score_b1[0] = detect(fluorescence, test_b1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	score_ab1[0] = detect(fluorescence, test_ab1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	score_d1[0] = detect(fluorescence, test_d1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	if score_a1[0] <= 15	|	true: jump bsbbif_2_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_3_f
bsbbif_4_t:
	dispose(test_b1[0])
bsbbif_5_f:
	PHI test_b2 = {test_b1,test_b}
	if score_ab1[0] <= 15	|	true: jump bsbbif_6_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_7_f
bsbbif_6_t:
	dispose(test_ab1[0])
bsbbif_7_f:
	PHI test_ab2 = {test_ab1,test_ab}
	if score_d1[0] <= 15	|	true: jump bsbbif_8_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_9_f
bsbbif_8_t:
	dispose(test_d1[0])
bsbbif_9_f:
	PHI test_d2 = {test_d1,test_d}
	hct_score1[0] = detect(fluorescence, test_hct1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	if hct_score1[0] <= 15	|	true: jump bsbbif_10_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_11_f
bsbbif_10_t:
	dispose(test_hct1[0])
bsbbif_11_f:
	PHI test_hct2 = {test_hct1,test_hct}
	dispose(test_a2[0])
	dispose(test_b2[0])
	dispose(test_ab2[0])
	dispose(test_d2[0])
	dispose(test_hct2[0])
	NOP
